text:
linda_support: Heads up: multiple customers reporting 502/504 from hosted inference API since ~09:20 UTC. Example trace: trace=trc_7a9c1f -> 502 Gateway. All errors hitting /v1/generate route and appear after recent rollout.

mike_ops: I'm seeing elevated 5xx on api-gateway -> kv-prefetch. Error pattern: upstream memcached-shard-3 connection reset. Errors jump at 09:18.

sean_eng: Quick sanity check of logs: memcached clients failing SASL auth (SASL auth failed, code=401) then pool churn. We rotated memcached creds during the deploy window at 09:17 per deploy logs.

deploy-bot: Auto-deploy started: rollout v2.4.1 @ 2026-03-17T09:17Z. Config change: enable_prefix_kv_auth_rotation=true.

alyssa_sre: If auth rotation happened mid-rollout, clients reconnecting will cause a thundering prefetch/fanout to KV layer. That can cascade into gateway 502/504s. Short-term mitigation: disable prefetch/fallback fanout and add larger client retry backoff.

jules_eng: Agreed. We should also circuit-break memcached failures so the gateway serves degraded responses instead of waiting for KV timeouts. Suggest setting max_prefetch_concurrency=8 and prefetch_backoff_ms=150.

linda_support: Customer repro (from ACME):
```
$ curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream: memcached-shard-3: connection reset by peer","trace":"trc_7a9c1f"}
```

mike_ops: I've temporarily disabled prefetch for the hosted tier on the affected routes and bumped gateway upstream timeout from 5s -> 10s. Observability: error-rate dropped but still noisy, watching.

redis-bot: memcached-shard-3 metrics: auth_failures spike 09:18–09:36, restart_count=3, accepted_conn_drop=42%.

alyssa_sre: I'll open an incident and loop in infra. Long-term: extend auth-grace-window during rotations and implement client-side credential refresh with exponential backoff. Hotfix: enable serve-stale-on-fallback for reads to avoid full fanout.

customer_jira_bot: Created ticket RED-5642 for ACME Inc. Priority P2. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5642.

jules_eng: Patch ready for canary: config diff:
```
max_prefetch_concurrency: 8
prefetch_backoff_ms: 150
kv_fallback_policy: "serve-stale-on-fallback"
```

mike_ops: Ops can temporarily re-enable old memcached creds for a 15m grace window while we push hotfix. We'll coordinate rotation timing.

alyssa_sre: Incident created (INC-2026-0317). I'll run targeted canary of the client patch and monitor 5xx rate and memcached auth metrics. If stable, roll to prod.

linda_support: Posting customer update now: "We're mitigating the issue — temporary measures applied and a patch rolling. We'll follow up with timeline." :thumbsup: Will update thread when customers confirm stability.
